ai_result.long_description:
Keep everyday essentials organized and close at hand with this handmade leather EDC belt pouch. Crafted from premium Italian vegetable-tanned leather, it offers a compact way to carry coins, cards and other small items without adding unnecessary bulk.

The pouch is designed to slide onto a standard belt for convenient access at your hip. Its compact interior can accommodate multiple credit cards, folded cash, a pocket knife or multitool, and small accessories such as keys, a flash drive or a lighter. The visible front flap features two round gold-tone fasteners and a neatly stitched leather construction.

Dimensions: 2.75 inches (70 mm) high × 4.33 inches (110 mm) wide × 0.98 inches (25 mm) deep. It fits standard belts up to 1.57 inches (40 mm) wide. A practical handmade gift for hunters, outdoor enthusiasts and anyone who appreciates organized everyday carry.
